meta.title: Marbella DJs & Events — This Month & Next
meta.policy: confirmed_only: every entry in `events` and `recurring_nights` is sourced from an official venue site or a primary ticketing platform, checked on the generated_at date above. Nothing was guessed or interpolated.
meta.how_to_use: Treat this as a manually-verified SNAPSHOT, not a live feed. Club and festival lineups in Marbella are typically only announced 1-4 weeks ahead, so this file will go stale quickly and under-represents what will actually happen. For a real 'live' feed in your app, re-run verification against the source_url fields on a schedule rather than treating this file as complete or permanent.
meta.time_field_note: start_time/end_time reflect the SPECIFIC event's published time when the source states one (time_confidence: 'event_specific'). Where a venue doesn't publish per-event times, we fall back to that venue's general published opening hours so the app always has something to show, but time_confidence is set to 'venue_general_hours' — treat those as approximate, not the DJ's actual set time.
known_gaps: FITZ Marbella (Puerto Banus) has publicly announced 10 hip-hop headliners for its 'Verano 2026' season plus a companion French-language urban/rap lineup ('Liberté': GIMS, Aya Nakamura, SDM, DYSTINCT, Soolking, Lacrim, Keblack, ElGrandeToto, Franglish) but as of the 2026-08-29 recheck still had not released specific calendar dates for either roster (fitzmarbella.com explicitly states dates 'se anunciarán de forma progresiva'). Songkick shows Tyga (one of the hip-hop headliners) already played FITZ on 2026-08-16 (before this window), suggesting the roster is partly live even though dates aren't published as a browsable calendar.

Olivia Valere, La Suite (Puente Romano), Aqwa Mist, Trocadero Arena, Buddha Beach, Karma Beach either render their event calendars via JavaScript (not readable by an automated fetch) or had no Aug/Sep 2026 dates published as of the check date. La Suite/Suite Club is reconfirmed absent from Puente Romano's own current 27-venue dining/nightlife directory — treated as retired/replaced by NYX + COYA Club.

Marbella Arena's own official site/Ticketmaster page could not be fetched (403); two Thomas Helmig dates (Sep 4 & 5) were added below sourced only from JamBase/Songkick/Shazam aggregator listings that corroborate each other — treat as likely rather than fully venue-confirmed.

Status flags (not dated events, but relevant): Funky Buddha Marbella appears closed (clubbable.com explicitly shows 'closed', 'No upcoming events'). Opium Beach Club appears closed (clubbable.com: 'Cerrado'). Funky Buddha Puerto Banús status is ambiguous (site live under 'Club Moonlight' branding, calendar empty/JS-rendered). Sisu Boutique Day Club's closure (reported elsewhere) could NOT be confirmed this run — its hotel and entertainment page both still appear live/bookable for 2026, so its status is contested rather than resolved either way.

Many aggregator sites (e.g. general nightlife blogs, marbsevents.com) show confident-looking September lineups that could NOT be verified against any official venue source and were deliberately excluded. Specifically this run: marbsevents.com listed Momento Marbella dates for Sinego (9/6), Guy Gerber (9/7), and Bedouin (9/29) that do not appear on Momento's own official programa page — cross-checking found matching 'Guy Gerber @ Momento' and 'Bedouin @ Momento' listings dated 2024 on Shazam, strongly suggesting marbsevents.com recycled stale prior-year data mislabeled as 2026. Excluded.

La Plage Casanis's Wednesday 'I ♥ WED' series (previously tracked with a dateless Sept 2 placeholder) no longer appears on the venue's own live calendar at all as of the 2026-08-29 recheck — only Sunday 'Sunset Ritual Sessions' entries are currently shown. Removed the Sept 2 placeholder pending reconfirmation; re-check before assuming the series has ended.

Ocean Club Marbella's Friday 'ELƎMENTS' daytime series is very likely OVER for the season: two independent third-party sources both state it ran 'every Friday from May 10th to August 30th', and no September instance or official end-date statement could be found either way. Recurring-night entry below updated to reflect this rather than presenting it as an ongoing weekly series.
Playa Padre's own site now shows a 'Season 2026' section on its /music/ page explicitly marked 'Coming Soon' — no concert dates are live there yet.

27 additional directory-listed nightclubs and beach clubs (Funky Buddha Marbella/Puerto Banús, Maya, Big Boss, The Local, Lemmon, Sunset Marbella, The Champagne Room, Bijou Banús, Scream, Seven, Casino Marbella, NOSSO Summer Club, Dune Beach Club, Mistral Beach, La Cabane Marbella, El Ancla Beach Club, Seasoul, Estrella del Mar, Opium Beach Club, Marbella Club Hotel Beach Club, Bora Bora Beach Club, Victor's Beach, Karma Beach Marbella, Buddha Beach, Barbillón Marbella, The Beach House, Sisu Boutique Day Club) were checked this run and had no text-readable, dated Aug/Sep 2026 event confirmable from an official or primary-ticketing source — see checked_but_no_confirmed_dates.

RESOLVED (2026-08-29): La Sala by the Sea's 'Le Bleu Pool Party' date conflict (one page said Aug 24 & Sep 21, another said Aug 29 & Sep 19) is resolved in favor of Aug 29 / Sep 19 — those are the only two dates that actually fall on a Saturday (Aug 24 and Sep 21, 2026 are both Mondays) and they carry live SevenRooms booking links; the dedicated Le Bleu page appears stale.

RESOLVED (2026-08-28, carried forward): 'Olivia Valère' and 'Suite Club' were removed as app venues — Olivia Valère's nightclub closed after an inheritance dispute and its address now operates as Bonbonniere Marbella (Mandala Group, 10-year lease); Suite Club/La Suite no longer appears on Puente Romano's own current nightlife page, which instead lists NYX (speakeasy nightclub) and COYA Club (dining-to-dancing venue).

IMPORTANT (carried forward): recurring_nights entries only render on the app's 'What's On' screen, NOT on Home's calendar or 'Upcoming in Marbella' strip (those read only from `events`, by date). Recurring-only venues need a specific dated instance added to `events` too to be visible on Home.

flagged_for_recheck.issue: Nikki Beach's site copy has previously labeled this event 'Friday, September 27, 2026', but September 27, 2026 actually falls on a Sunday (independently verified via date computation on 2026-08-29). The live happenings page no longer repeats a weekday label at all, so the error may have been silently corrected upstream, but the date itself (Sunday, Sep 27) is confirmed correct. Also note: the SevenRooms booking link for this event uses the slug 'red-again-closing-party', and a separate nikkibeach.com page 'Red Again – Season Closing' exists with matching red-dress-code/season-closing copy but no posted date — both URLs likely refer to the same underlying event; re-verify before assuming these are two separate events.

Re-checked 2026-08-29: found a starlitefestival.com page for a 'Daddy' event, but it lists the date as 'Saturday, August 1st' (not Aug 29) and links to a different ticket slug ('after-party-db28i8') than the original source. This does not corroborate the existing Aug 29 date — left the event's date as originally sourced (entradas.starlitemarbella.com listing) but time/price fields remain null pending a corrected, unambiguous source. Do not trust the Aug 1 date found this run.

Tibu's Fatsoma listings show two separately-ticketed events at the same venue, same night (2026-08-30), same 23:00-06:00 slot, same £52.80 bank-holiday price: 'La Capitale' and 'Marbebe'. Both are reported as-is without resolving the apparent overlap — may be two rooms/floors, a listing error, or a rename in progress.

This instance of Tibu's recurring Thursday 'Red Cup Party' is listed with hours 23:00-06:00 on Fatsoma, while the other three dated Red Cup Party instances in this dataset (09-01 Noir aside) show 23:00-05:00. Reported as source-stated, not corrected.
